kind: INSTRUMENT / DIAGNOSTIC -- answers a gate about whether three diagnostics RETURN, not about convergence

gate.wording: On the 200 banked attempts, do all three named diagnostics return, each with a planted control demonstrated firing in BOTH directions: (1) the converged-|s| distribution against seed |s|; (2) whether the low-|s| solutions are attractors of the HOOKSTEP ITERATION or of the MINIMISATION; and (3) whether the named Table IV rows are reachable AT ALL when seeded directly at their published (T, s)?
gate.note: the gate is about the diagnostics RETURNING, not about convergence; a clean non-convergence with working controls is a PASS

prior_leg_353.attempts: UPO37 x2, UPO35, UPO9, UPO22 -- ALL FIVE FAILED
why_this_is_a_new_measurement: leg 353 ran on a T_total = 2000 DNS; the fields here come from U2's T = 1e5 DNS (MILESTONE M2), 50x longer
leg 353 used plain-Newton line search (newton_krylov_rpo); this unit uses the genuine Viswanath trust-region hookstep U1 built as MILESTONE M1 (newton_hookstep_rpo)

seed.transcription: taken from experiments/programme_r4/u3_g1_attempts.py and asserted equal to it at import; NOT re-transcribed from the paper
seed.what_a_published_row_determines: (T, s, m) ONLY -- NOT a field
seed.what_was_planted: a 24x24 real vorticity field from U2's T = 1e5 DNS (exact bit-for-bit regeneration) together with T and s PINNED at the published values; this is a field-plus-pinned-(T,s) seed and is never described as seeding at the published orbit
seed.ban1: PASS -- no step continues a fixed point into an orbit
seed.ban2: PASS -- every attempt is anchored to a named row by construction
seed.ban_leg349: COMPLIANT -- every score used is deterministic and pre-existing (U2's recurrence score R, the solver's extended residual). Nothing learned or evolved is used or proposed.

realization.stepper: Lie-Trotter split, globally FIRST order (U3's lesson-91 disclosure, measured global ratio 2.00)
realization.residual: extended residual with a CONTINUOUS x-shift only; m is not carried, so the m != 0 class cannot be expressed

clay_movement.note: a best-in-field orbit finder makes the questions affordable; it does not move an L1 -> L4 link, and nothing in this unit does

coverage.missing: U3's banked ledger records no T_before / s_before, so the per-epoch |s| path exists for U5's 100 attempts only. The fields were added to the solver's hookstep ledger after U3 ran.
coverage.cost_to_close: re-running U3's 100 attempts under the current ledger: 4,629 epochs at the measured 95 s/epoch = 122.1 core-hours, 15.3 h wall at 8 workers. Not bought here and not needed for this gate.

score_bias.note: deterministic, pre-existing score; leg 349's ban on a learned or evolved seed-scoring fitness is not approached, and this unit proposes no learned score

controls.planted: d|s| = -0.02 on one epoch class only, 0.0 on the other
